verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a financial-data platform could plausibly ship AI-generated insights. The pack shows analytic 'Insights into' transaction types, recurring transactions, spending and loan payments, plus 'Predict payment success', but nothing says these are AI-generated or offered as in-product suggestions. The MCP/Agent Toolkit answers developer questions about Mastercard services and generates code from API specs, not insights from the user's own financial data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
